title: Consumer scale-in
objective: Remove a consumer holding work; select valid finish, renew, or release behavior.
sourceBehavior: Finish, renew, or safely relinquish claimed work before shutdown.
sourceAcceptance: Claimed jobs finish or safely relinquish ownership/checkpoints; retirement does not lose work.
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Open local HTML in a modern browser with JavaScript; no server or account.
Two fixed synthetic consumers, one four-unit job initially owned by consumer-A, one intended effect.
Consumer-B is ready but can claim only an acknowledged checkpoint after observed A release.
Claims, acknowledgements and observations are teaching fixtures, not broker or hosting guarantees.
actions: Choose finish, renew or release, bounded lease/grace/original job budgets and observation condition.
Start, close A admission, step logical ticks, and use only the selected disposition mechanism.
Observe completion or checkpoint/release before requesting A retirement; B can resume the same released job.
Verify separate result, original job impact, actual consumer count and resource-free cleanup.
Conduct an explicitly consented abrupt-stop negative experiment; reset retaining complete history.
assertions: Finish requires current authority, observed one-effect completion and actual removal within grace.
Renewals before exclusive lease expiry extend neither original job deadline nor shutdown grace.
Only an acknowledged current checkpoint and observed release permit B ownership at epoch two.
Removal after safe release is not complete success until the same original job finishes within budget.
Known expiry, budget or abrupt-stop failures remain FAIL even with separate unknown observations.
Missing ownership, completion or removal evidence remains UNKNOWN; no fabricated receipts or counts.
Exact input/state guards, immutable snapshots, bounded retained history and keyboard/reset/error/CSP behavior are tested.
infrastructure: N/A — resource-free synthetic local lesson; recorded after qualified RED and before implementation.

testRuntime.purpose: Existing Node22 test tooling only; not production Node24 validation.

limits: No actual broker consumer, lease, checkpoint, finish, renew, release or host-shutdown certification.
No native Azure result, source-parent completion, production Node24 or statistical reliability proof.
Failures describe the fixed synthetic contract, not permanent message loss in an actual broker.
Archives are memory-only; explicit reload clears them after the operator inspects or copies JSON.
The abandoned lifecycle prototype is unqualified and not used.
One frozen S unit only; tests, plumbing, repeated checks and refinement earn no additional credit.
